light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the cluttered background stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, the side near the opening a little brighter and cooler, the far corners dimmer. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, small blemishes and uneven tone; hair with stray strands; clothes with real creases, dust and wear. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld home video filmed by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the room in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural hands; people move naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

clips.text: Esta la pegué igual, el mismo día, con la misma receta. Con una sola diferencia: leche entera.
clips.action: he taps the blue tape on the board and then the carton of whole milk. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.text: Porque es la que casi todo el mundo tiene en el refrigerador, y la receta dice "leche", y ya.
clips.action: he shrugs, holding the whole milk carton up. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.text: Recién sacada de la prensa, parecía perfecta. Firme. Pero mira lo que pasa ahora.
clips.action: he grips the two boards of the taped joint with both hands. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.text: Se abrió por la cola, no por la madera. Y mira la cara: grasosa, opaca. Casi no agarró las fibras.
clips.action: he shows one of the opened faces close to the lens, rubbing it with his thumb. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.who: the neighbour, a stout man of about 65 with a thick grey moustache and a light-blue checked shirt (the fourth reference image)
clips.voice: in Spanish with a neutral Latin American accent, the gruff, amused voice of a 65-year-old man
clips.action: The neighbour leans in and looks at the opened joint, frowning, then asks the presenter; the presenter listens, silent.

clips.text: Todo por la grasa. La grasa de la leche se queda metida en la cuajada, y la cola no moja bien la madera.
clips.action: he answers the neighbour, then turns to the lens, pointing at the two milk cartons. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.text: Por eso las recetas de cola de caseína piden leche descremada. No es un capricho: es lo que hace que pegue.
clips.action: he taps the skimmed milk carton twice with his finger. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.text: Y a las pocas horas parece que pegó, pero cuando le cargas peso, al otro día, se abre así. Por eso: descremada. Siempre.
clips.action: he picks up the skimmed milk carton and holds it next to his face. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.text: Y si sólo tienes entera: lava la cuajada con agua tibia en vez de fría. Se lleva parte de la grasa. Ayuda, pero no es lo mismo.
clips.action: he mimes rinsing curds under a tap with his hands. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.
